text:
maria: Starting preflight for the region-by-region rollout. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, canaries in each region (2% traffic). Pin: model v3.4.1 for US/EU, APAC will start pinned to v3.4.0 until heatcheck passes. Change window: 02:00-05:00 UTC.
kevin: Ack. SRE to confirm reserved warm pool sizes per region?
noah: Reserving warm pools: US 60 GPUs, EU 40 GPUs, APAC 30 GPUs. Those are soft reserves, can scale +20% if smoke looks healthy.
sophie: Will set autoscale min to match. Also toggling KV cache pre-warm for v3.4.1.
maria: Deploy-bot: run preflight checks for US slice now. Post results here.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight-run: region=us slice=canary model=v3.4.1 checks=(quota,thermal,latency,kv-warm) status=IN_PROGRESS
kevin: Keeping an eye on thermal thresholds. If host temp > 80C we want immediate throttle and pin rollback.
maria: Rollback criteria summary: 1) P50 latency jump > 45% vs baseline for > 5m, 2) error rate > 0.8% sustained 3m, 3) infra thermal or OOM spikes.
sophie: Confirming logs will stream to /prod/rollouts/1714829999. I added an alert rule for p50 delta in the release dashboard.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight-run: region=us slice=canary model=v3.4.1 checks=(quota:OK,thermal:OK,latency:OK,kv-warm:OK) status=PASS
maria: Nice. Kicking canary traffic to 2% now. Please watch token-level cost heat (batching change) — Optimize suggested a different batch config for v3.4.1 but we are keeping default for canary.
kevin: Observability ready. I’ll watch per-route token costs and queue depth. If queue depth > 12 for >3m, hold and scale.
noah: US canary at 2% now. No immediate red flags.
kevin: Saw a small transient p90 blip at t+90s, resolved. Not actionable.
sophie: EU warmpool spin-up started (40 GPUs). Estimated warm ready in ~6m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary-progress: region=us traffic=2% duration=7m errors=0.06% p50_delta=+3% status=STABLE
maria: Proceeding to EU after 10m stabilization window. EU will be pinned to v3.4.1 too. APAC stays pinned to v3.4.0 until global metrics stable for 30m.
kevin: One ops note: if EU thermal headroom <15% on any host, reduce canary and alert SRE.
noah: EU canary starting ramp: 0.5% -> 2% over 8m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight-run: region=eu slice=canary model=v3.4.1 checks=(quota:OK,thermal:OK,latency:OK,kv-warm:WARN) status=PASS_WITH_WARNINGS
sophie: kv-warm warning is expected; cache miss rate will stabilize after ~10m of traffic. Not blocking.
maria: Good. Reminder: release notes posted (link) — includes known diff between 3.4.0 -> 3.4.1 (attention perf, minor reranking tweak).
kevin: EU canary metrics look clean. p50 +2%, errors 0.04%, no infra pressure.
noah: EU at 2% steady. Rolling US+EU to 20% over the next hour if stable.
maria: Before we ramp, we need sign-off on rollback play: A) immediate pin to v3.4.0 for region, B) route shift to dedicated fallback model (v3.3.x) if pin fails, C) create incident channel and page SRE if errors >1.5% in 5m.
kevin: Sounds good. Also add thermal auto-throttle to the playbook.
sophie: Implemented auto-throttle policy for high-temp hosts and added explicit drain hooks.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] eu-rollout: model=v3.4.1 target=20% over 1h initial=2% status=SCHEDULED
maria: APAC will not join the ramp this evening — we’ll re-evaluate after a 30m global stability window. APAC ops, confirm you have bandwidth tomorrow morning for follow-up.
noah: APAC ops confirmed for morning handoff (08:00 APAC timezone).
maria: Final checklist: - release notes link shared - rollback play acknowledged - warm pools reserved - alerts set - canaries passing -> proceed to gradual ramp. If anyone sees anything odd, ping here and we hit manual hold. :raised_hands:
kevin: Roger. I’ll keep monitoring.
sophie: Standby to adjust autoscale thresholds.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] summary: us=canary PASS, eu=canary PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, scheduled_ramp=us+eu->20% at 1714831800 UTC, apac=hold pinned v3.4.0
maria: Thanks team — will update channels once ramp starts.
kevin: thumbs up :thumbsup:
